column2: Citavi 6 users have to confirm that they are still members of your organization. Depending on your chosen settings, this can be accomplished by (a) clicking the confirmation link in the email; (b) logging in to Shibboleth; (c) entering a voucher code. No license information is copied and then entered in Citavi.\r\n##newline\r\nCitavi 5 users have to log in to their Citavi accounts. There, the license key can be found and must be copied to the Clipboard. It can then be entered in Citavi 5. Users can also request license keys for earlier versions of Citavi. Please see  ##helpgetoldversion for more information.
column3: Citavi 6 用户必须确认他们仍为您组织的成员。根据您所选的设置，可通过以下方式完成：(a) 单击电子邮件中的确认链接；(b) 登录 Shibboleth;(c) 输入优惠券代码。不会复制任何许可证信息并输入到 Citavi 中。\r\n##newline\r\nCitavi 5 用户必须登录其 Citavi 账户。在那里可以找到许可证密钥，必须将其复制到剪贴板，然后可在 Citavi 5 中输入。用户还可以申请旧版 Citavi 的许可证密钥。有关更多信息，请参阅  ##helpgetoldversion。
